subject.title: Dashboard: full-bleed tab layout + "tab app" bundle

question: Should OpenClaw accept full-bleed tab-app layout as bundled modular-dashboard work after the dashboard base lands, or should tab-app bundles stay external until the sandbox and storage model is approved?
rationale: The request is plausible web-frontend ergonomics work, but it changes a default-facing dashboard surface and relies on security-sensitive custom-widget behavior that automation cannot product-approve.

options.title: Keep As Gated Wave 2 Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the focused full-bleed/tab-app follow-up and require the dashboard base plus sandbox/storage decisions to settle first.

options.title: Prove Externally First
options.body: Ask for the tab-app bundle convention to prove out as an external plugin or ClawHub package while OpenClaw exposes only missing generic seams.

options.title: Defer Apps Layer
options.body: Pause or reject the apps-layer direction if bundled dashboard app surfaces are not current product work.

recommendation.title: Keep As Gated Wave 2 Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the focused full-bleed/tab-app follow-up and require the dashboard base plus sandbox/storage decisions to settle first.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main ownership signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and related bundled dashboard product/security boundary.
